name: jev-traits
description: Checks each edit against the repository's traits (.agents/traits) with TypeSafe Jev and tells Claude what to fix

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Kept in secure storage. Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY or the macOS Keychain item typesafe-api-key.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: The System One model that judges each trait.

check_edits.title: Check every edit
check_edits.description: Check each Edit, Write and NotebookEdit as it happens.

fix_threshold.title: Fix threshold
fix_threshold.description: Violation probability at which Claude is told to fix the code.

check_threshold.title: Double-check threshold
check_threshold.description: Violation probability at which Claude is told to double-check the code.

pass_threshold.title: Pass threshold
pass_threshold.description: check_traits reports a judgment as unsure when compliant plus not-applicable falls below this.
